title: Deterministic reachability validator against movement.json
summary: The validator every generated route must pass: a deterministic reachability search that accepts a route segment only if each transition is achievable under config/movement.json with a 15% margin (85% of max reach and distance). Shared movement contract with the controller.

acceptance_tests.test: Given a traversal graph and a proposed route, the validator returns valid/invalid per segment, using only config/movement.json constants at an 85% margin; identical input yields identical output.
Property tests cover unreachable summit, a gap just over 85% of max distance (rejected) and just under (accepted), and the beat-1 verb restriction.
The validator loads the shared constants via services/traversal/movement.py (M0-MOVE-01); no movement number is duplicated.
Reviewed by gj-gameplay so the validator and the controller agree on the constants.
